Answer: B
Reason: The chest X-rays demonstrate a massive right-sided pneumothorax with significant mediastinal shift and an abnormal, rotated cardiac silhouette displaced into the right hemithorax, which is characteristic of cardiac volvulus following extrapleural pneumonectomy for mesothelioma. This mechanical torsion of the heart explains the acute haemodynamic compromise better than simple tension pneumothorax or hemorrhage alone.
